{3: 'A basic defensive line is now in place. Some soldiers lean against barriers or supply crates, cleaning weapons and catching their breath, while others move in a constant, practiced flow that defines life at the front.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Rosetta', 3: 'All units, do not overextend. If anything goes wrong, fall back to the base immediately.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Bionic Ursa', 3: 'Reconnaissance, not annihilation, we remember. Leave it to us, Rosetta.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '12'}
{3: 'As the ARU captain signs off, Rosetta lets out a long, slow breath, the kind you release after the tension of a fight has finally passed.'}
{2: 'Things not looking good?', 3: '32', 4: 'Is there anything I can do?', 5: '35'}
{2: 'Rosetta', 3: 'The situation is under control. Having so many dependable allies helps.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Rosetta', 3: "I was just venting a little battlefield pressure. My M.I.N.D. hasn't been entirely stable lately, and I need to regulate myself—for my sake, and to keep things easier for you, Commandant.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rosetta', 3: "Thank you, Commandant, but you've already done more than enough. I'm not tired... just not accustomed to giving orders to so many at once.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rosetta', 3: "By the way, while the recon team scouts the Corrupted production lines, let's go over our unit's objectives.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Go on.', 3: '40', 4: 'I remember everything. No need for a review.', 5: '48'}
{2: 'Rosetta', 3: "As agreed earlier, the alliance forces' tactical priority shifts to destroying the Corrupted production lines inside Sophiasburgh.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rosetta', 3: "If we cut off their reinforcements, we can break out of this situation where we're constantly outnumbered.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'I wonder how many there will be...', 3: '43'}
{2: 'Rosetta', 3: "Every factory we take out matters. They are designed to be small-scale, so each one's individual production capacity is limited.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rosetta', 3: 'So if we keep winning the local engagements and keep disrupting their production, overturning the numbers game is only a matter of time.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rosetta', 3: 'When that happens, we press the advantage with a full assault. And when it comes to striking hard, I have complete faith in everyone here.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rosetta', 3: "Indeed. You've been part of planning this from the start, Commandant. Let's skip the recap.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Scout', 3: 'Reporting! Teams for the sabotage op are ready.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Rosetta', 3: 'Understood.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Rosetta', 3: "Commandant, once reconnaissance confirms the targets, we strike the production lines in coordination. Let's use this time to prepare. I want this operation to run smoothly.", 4: '1'}
